[LCCO.5.3] The capture fact's lifetime must equal the maximum of
the `ttl` of each fact the call's continuations match — the service's
response schema ([LCRS.4.3.2]) and `CallError` ([LCRS.4.2.1]) — and the largest `timeout`
duration declared on the call. The compiler must compute this lifetime at
lowering time and assert it as the capture fact's TTL.

The largest `timeout` keeps the capture live until the call's last deadline, so
an answer that arrives before it can still join an `on` or `error` sibling
([LCCO.7.3]). No `timeout` sibling joins the capture ([LCCO.7.2]), so its
lifetime decides nothing about whether a timeout fires.
